name: @stellarproof/backend-load-tests
description: Load and concurrency tests for StellarProof backend KMS rotation and worker pipeline

scripts.test:load:all: npm run test:load:kms && npm run test:load:worker
scripts.test:load:all:dev: npm run test:load:kms:dev && npm run test:load:worker:dev
scripts.test:load:all:light: npm run test:load:kms:light && npm run test:load:worker:light
scripts.test:load:all:stress: npm run test:load:kms:stress && npm run test:load:worker:stress
scripts.test:load:sequential: npm run test:load:kms && sleep 10 && npm run test:load:worker
